english_meaning: A large self-service store selling food, household goods, and other items.
gujarati_meaning: એક મોટી સ્વ-સેવા દુકાન જ્યાં ખોરાક, ઘરવખરી અને અન્ય ચીજો વેચાય છે.
usage_note: Used for large stores with many departments under one roof.
examples: I buy vegetables from the supermarket every week.
The supermarket is open until midnight.
She found a great deal at the supermarket.
The supermarket has a bakery section.

english_meaning: A small shop selling fashionable clothes or accessories.
gujarati_meaning: એક નાની દુકાન જ્યાં ફેશનેબલ કપડાં અથવા ઍક્સેસરીઝ વેચાય છે.
usage_note: Usually implies a small, stylish, and often expensive shop.
memory_tip: 'Boutique' = ફ્રેન્ચ શબ્દ, નાની ફેન્સી દુકાન — like a VIP shop!
examples: She bought her wedding dress from a boutique.
The boutique on Main Street sells imported clothes.
They opened a boutique specializing in handmade jewelry.
The boutique was beautifully decorated.

english_meaning: A shop where medicines and healthcare products are sold.
gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં દવાઓ અને આરોગ્ય સંબંધી ઉત્પાદનો વેચાય છે.
usage_note: In British English 'chemist' is used; in American English 'drugstore' or 'pharmacy'.
examples: Pick up my prescription from the pharmacy.
The pharmacy is next to the clinic.
She works as a pharmacist at the pharmacy.
The pharmacy stocks vitamins and supplements.

english_meaning: An outdoor market where people sell second-hand goods at low prices.
gujarati_meaning: એક ખુલ્લું બજાર જ્યાં લોકો સસ્તા ભાવે જૂની ચીજો વેચે છે.
usage_note: Often held on weekends; great for bargain hunting.
memory_tip: 'Flea' = ચાંચડ (નાનો) → નાની-નાની સસ્તી ચીજો મળે એ flea market.
examples: I found antique coins at the flea market.
The flea market opens every Sunday morning.
She loves browsing flea markets for vintage items.
They sold homemade crafts at the flea market.

english_meaning: A small shop open long hours selling everyday essential items.
gujarati_meaning: એક નાની દુકાન જે લાંબા સમય સુધી ખુલ્લી રહે અને રોજની જરૂરી ચીજો વેચે.
usage_note: Typically more expensive than supermarkets due to convenience.
examples: I grabbed a snack from the convenience store.
The convenience store is open 24 hours.
She stopped at the convenience store for milk.
Convenience stores often sell lottery tickets.

english_meaning: A large retail store with separate sections for different types of goods.
gujarati_meaning: એક મોટી દુકાન જ્યાં જુદા-જુદા પ્રકારની ચીજો માટે અલગ-અલગ વિભાગ હોય.
usage_note: Examples: Walmart, Marks & Spencer, Shoppers Stop.
memory_tip: 'Department' = વિભાગ → department store = ઘણા વિભાગ વાળી દુકાન.
examples: We bought furniture from the department store.
The department store has a sale every Christmas.
She works in the cosmetics section of a department store.
The department store spans five floors.

english_meaning: A market where goods are sold in large quantities at lower prices, usually to retailers.
gujarati_meaning: એક બજાર જ્યાં ઘણો મોટો જથ્થો ઓછા ભાવે, ખાસ કરીને વેપારીઓને, વેચાય છે.
usage_note: Wholesale is cheaper per unit but requires buying in bulk.
memory_tip: 'Whole' = આખો/બધો → wholesale = બધો માલ એકસાથે ખરીદવો.
examples: Shopkeepers buy goods from the wholesale market.
The wholesale market opens early in the morning.
She visited the wholesale market to stock her store.
Prices at the wholesale market are much lower.

english_meaning: A shop where manufacturers sell products directly at discounted prices.
gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં ઉત્પાદક સીધા ઘટાડેલા ભાવે ઉત્પાદનો વેચે છે.
usage_note: Often located outside city centers; sells last season's stock or slight defects.
memory_tip: 'Outlet' = બહાર નીકળવાનો રસ્તો → manufacturer નો outlet = factory outlet store.
examples: I bought branded shoes from the outlet store.
The outlet store has up to 70% off.
She found designer handbags at the outlet.
Outlet stores are popular during holiday sales.

english_meaning: A shop where people can borrow money by leaving valuable items as security.
gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં ઘરેણા જેવી કીમતી વસ્તુ ગિરવી મૂકીને પૈસા ઉધાર મળે છે.
usage_note: If you repay the loan with interest, you get your item back.
memory_tip: 'Pawn' = ગિરવી → pawnshop = ગિરવી દુકાન (ઘરેણું ગિરવી, પૈસા મળે).
examples: He pawned his watch at the pawnshop.
The pawnshop gave her a loan against her gold ring.
She redeemed her jewelry from the pawnshop.
Pawnshops offer quick cash in emergencies.

english_meaning: A shop selling second-hand goods, often run by charities.
gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં ઉપયોગ થઈ ગયેલ ચીજો વેચાય છે, ઘણી વખત ધર્માદો સંસ્થા ચલાવે.
usage_note: Very popular in the US and UK; eco-friendly shopping option.
memory_tip: 'Thrift' = કરકસર → thrift store = કરકસર ભરી ખરીદી (સસ્તી, વાપરેલ ચીજો).
examples: She found a vintage jacket at the thrift store.
Thrift stores help reduce waste.
He donated old books to the thrift store.
Thrift shopping is trendy among young people.

english_meaning: A place where goods are sold to the highest bidder through a public sale.
gujarati_meaning: એક સ્થળ જ્યાં ચીજો જાહેર હરાજી દ્વારા સૌથી વધુ ભાવ આપનારને વેચાય.
usage_note: Famous auction houses include Sotheby's and Christie's.
examples: The painting sold for millions at the auction house.
She bid on antique furniture at the auction house.
Auction houses deal in art, jewelry, and collectibles.
He attended an auction house event last month.

english_meaning: A person or shop that sells flowers and floral arrangements.
gujarati_meaning: એક વ્યક્તિ અથવા દુકાન જ્યાં ફૂલ અને ફૂલ સજાવટ વેચાય છે.
usage_note: A florist can also arrange custom bouquets for events.
examples: She ordered a bouquet from the florist.
The florist arranged flowers for the wedding.
The florist is open on Valentine's Day.
He works as a florist and loves his job.

english_meaning: A shop that sells writing materials, paper, pens, and office supplies.
gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં કાગળ, પેન, ઑફિસ સ્ટેશનરી અને લખવા-ભણવાની ચીજો મળે.
memory_tip: 'Stationery' → 'e' for envelope → pen, paper, envelope — stationery shop!
examples: She bought notebooks from the stationery shop.
The stationery shop sells art supplies too.
Children visit the stationery shop before school.
The stationery shop is near the library.

english_meaning: A shop selling cooked meats, cheeses, and fine prepared foods.
gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં રાંધેલ માંસ, ચીઝ અને તૈયાર ખાસ ખોરાક મળે છે.
usage_note: Commonly shortened to 'deli'. Often sells sandwiches and imported foods.
examples: He bought smoked salmon from the delicatessen.
The delicatessen makes excellent sandwiches.
She visited the deli for imported cheese.
The delicatessen is known for its gourmet products.

english_meaning: A shop selling tools, building materials, and home improvement products.
gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં સાધનો, બાંધકામ સામગ્રી અને ઘર સુધારણાની ચીજો મળે.
usage_note: In the UK, often called a 'DIY store' or 'ironmonger'.
memory_tip: 'Hard' + 'ware' = ઠોસ/કઠણ ચીજો → hardware store = ઓજારો ને સાધનોની દુકાન.
examples: Dad went to the hardware store to buy nails.
The hardware store sells paint and brushes.
She found a good drill at the hardware store.
The hardware store is helpful for home repairs.

english_meaning: A shop where books are sold.
gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં પુસ્તકો વેચાય છે.
usage_note: 'Bookstore' is American English; 'bookshop' is British English.
examples: She spent hours browsing the bookstore.
The bookstore has a great children's section.
He bought a novel from the bookstore.
The bookstore hosts author signing events.

english_meaning: A shop that sells rings, necklaces, bracelets, and other ornaments.
gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાน જ્યાં વીંટી, હાર, બંગડી અને અન્ય ઘરેણા વેચાય છે.
usage_note: 'Jewellery' is British spelling; 'jewelry' is American spelling.
examples: She bought gold earrings from the jewellery shop.
The jewellery shop has a wide collection.
He proposed with a ring from the local jewellery shop.
The jewellery shop offers free engraving.
